text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the weigh-in! In this corner stands a patient counter-striker who throws long kicks at range, lands heavy counters up close, and will throw you right through your guard. A brand new build, clean and honestly documented, with all thirty required clips plus three bonus ones. The judge praised the paperwork but spotted poreless skin, painted eyes and sculpted hair, so this debut scores forty for realism. Standing one point eight seven meters tall, the Patient Poet of Pain, MUSE!
